# t22.1 — PHP 8.2 Composer Dependency Compatibility

## Result

Resolved the PHP platform blocker without changing the approved PHP 8.2 / Laravel 12 target or using `--ignore-platform-reqs`.

- `composer.json`: changed `coding-libs/laravel-mfa` from `^2.0` to `^1.1` and `spatie/laravel-permission` from `^8.3` to `^6.25`.
- `composer.lock`: locked `coding-libs/laravel-mfa` at `v1.1.6` and `spatie/laravel-permission` at `6.25.0`; removed the now-unneeded `spatie/laravel-package-tools`.
- Preserved the existing Laravel `v12.72.0` lock update from t16. Preserved, without modifying, the pre-existing `composer.json` `scripts.test` working-tree change.
- No application source or runtime tests were changed or executed.

The MFA downgrade is metadata-only between the published v1.1.6 and v2.0.0 tags: the upstream comparison shows dependency constraints changed, with no package PHP source changes. Spatie v6.25.0 supports PHP `^8.0` and Illuminate 12. Its v7/v8 releases require PHP 8.3; reviewed application usages are the established `HasRoles`, role/permission models, role assignment/checks, and permission-cache reset APIs. The application does not reference the renamed v7 event/command classes or removed `clearClassPermissions()` API. Existing config has events disabled and retains the v6-supported model/table/team-resolver settings. This is a package-major rollback, so runtime behavioral validation remains a residual gate.

## Validation

- `composer validate --no-check-publish --no-interaction --no-plugins` — passed.
- `composer check-platform-reqs --lock --no-interaction --no-plugins` — passed on PHP 8.2.12; all locked platform requirements satisfied.
- `composer install --dry-run --no-scripts --no-plugins --no-interaction --no-progress` — passed; Composer confirmed the lock is installable on this platform.
- `git diff --check -- composer.json composer.lock` — passed.
- The lockfile review found only the two requested package updates, removal of the no-longer-required package-tools dependency, and preservation of t16's Laravel framework update; Composer-generated metadata-only format churn was reverted.

All Composer resolution/validation commands disabled scripts and plugins. No install was performed. No `.env` file was inspected, read, printed, searched, copied, uploaded, or otherwise processed. No database access/migration, deployment, router/infrastructure operation, or commit was performed.

## Test Results

- Commands executed: Composer manifest validation, locked platform requirement check, Composer install dry-run, and scoped `git diff --check` (listed above).
- Passed: 4 validation checks.
- Failed: 0.
- Skipped: 1 application test/build suite.
- Details: PHPUnit/E2E were not run because they can bootstrap the application and load `.env`, which is explicitly prohibited. The dry-run and platform check establish lock-level PHP 8.2 compatibility, not application runtime behavior.

## Evidence Mapping

- `t17-architect.md#F-01` + `clarification.md#Backend` → `composer.json` keeps PHP `^8.2` and Laravel `^12.0`; updated package constraints and lock versions → successful PHP 8.2.12 locked-platform check and install dry-run.
- Packagist metadata and [coding-libs/laravel-mfa v1.1.6 composer.json](https://github.com/coding-libs/laravel-mfa/blob/v1.1.6/composer.json) → MFA lock requires PHP `>=8.2` and Illuminate `^11|^12`; [v1.1.6…v2.0.0 comparison](https://github.com/coding-libs/laravel-mfa/compare/v1.1.6...v2.0.0) → no package source changes in that version transition.
- [spatie/laravel-permission v6.25.0 composer.json](https://github.com/spatie/laravel-permission/blob/6.25.0/composer.json) → PHP `^8.0` and Illuminate `^12` are supported; [v8.0.0 changelog](https://github.com/spatie/laravel-permission/blob/8.0.0/CHANGELOG.md) → v7/v8 migration-only removals/renames compared with app's reviewed common API usage.
- `composer.lock#platform` → PHP `^8.2` remains unchanged; Composer check reports PHP 8.2.12 success without ignored requirements.

## Findings and Residual Risk

- HIGH/CRITICAL findings remaining for this task: none.
- Application runtime behavior is not proven here because executing tests risks processing `.env`; the independent runtime gate must account for the same prohibition.
- The Spatie 8.x-to-6.x major rollback warrants full application regression coverage when it can be run without processing `.env`.
